reasoning: This is an abstract UI formatting/layout glyph (vertical align bottom or move between bounds) that strongly resembles a standard download arrow. Because it is interface chrome rather than a concrete object, and is nearly indistinguishable from several other arrow-and-bar icons at list size, it makes a poor subject icon for tasks.
